subjects.name: राजस्थान का भूगोल [Geography of Rajasthan]
subjects.scope_note: Covers the geography of Rajasthan, including its physical features, climate, resources, population, and infrastructure. Excludes general geographical concepts not specific to Rajasthan.

subjects.name: राजस्थान का इतिहास, कला एवं संस्कृति [History, Art and Culture of Rajasthan]
subjects.name_hindi: राजस्थान का इतिहास, कला एवं संस्कृति
subjects.scope_note: Focuses on the history, art, culture, and social life of Rajasthan, including historical events, personalities, language, literature, folk traditions, and architecture. Excludes general Indian history or culture.

subjects.name: सामान्य विज्ञान [General Science]
subjects.scope_note: Covers fundamental concepts in physics, chemistry, and biology, including physical and chemical changes, metals, non-metals, light, genetics, human anatomy, diseases, and waste management. Excludes advanced scientific topics or applications specific to animal husbandry.

subjects.name: गणित [Mathematics]
subjects.scope_note: Includes topics such as HCF & LCM, average, profit-loss, percentage, simple interest, compound interest, and ratio-proportion. Excludes advanced mathematics or geometry.

subjects.name: पशुपालन [Animal Husbandry]
subjects.section: पशुपालन और समसामयिक घटनाएँ [Animal Husbandry and Current Affairs]
subjects.scope_note: Covers aspects of animal reproduction, digestion, respiration, diseases, characteristics, habitat, conservation, nutritive value of animal products, animal agriculture, poultry farming, shepherds, and wild animals/resources. Excludes general biology or zoology not directly related to animal husbandry.

subjects.name: प्रमुख सम-सामयिक घटनाएँ [Major Current Events]
subjects.section: पशुपालन और समसामयिक घटनाएँ [Animal Husbandry and Current Affairs]
subjects.scope_note: Includes current affairs related to sports, politics, economy, social, geographical, cultural, ecological, and technical fields, state & national issues, famous personalities, and government programs/policies. Excludes historical events or static general knowledge.
